content:
- Ran .ralph/task_switch.sh successfully; current task moved out of current_tasks and into current_tasks_done, task_history updated, email sent.
- current_task.txt is gone after task switch, as expected.
- Next: git add all changed/untracked files, commit with required message, push.

- Choose-Task read .ralph/current_tasks.md and .ralph/current_tasks_done.md.
- Active candidates are three unblocked non-bug failing tasks: story 15 HTTP concurrency validation, story 17 testing/e2e setup, and story 18 final acceptance.
- No active bug tasks were present in current_tasks.md; no priority or blocked_by tags were present in the candidate task files.
- Selected story 15 because it is the earliest remaining concrete verification task and should precede broad testing infrastructure and final acceptance hardening.

- Read current task: .ralph/tasks/15-story-http-concurrency-model/01-task-validate-http-concurrency-model.md.
- Task is not_started with no existing plan artifacts under story 15.
- Per Ralph workflow, this is a planning turn: inspect existing HTTP rate-limit/client/startup boundaries, create plan artifact, update task to reference plan and NOW EXECUTE, then quit immediately.

- Inspected HTTP limiter, startup manager, nsxclient, stateoperator, and existing mockapi-backed tests.
- Key design finding: generic limiter exists, but startup manager currently constructs NSX clients without an HTTPClient, so production manager clients do not share the rate-limited transport.
- Planning fix: create one shared rate-limited http.Client in startup.NewManager and pass it into every nsxclient.NewClient call from the managerClientFactory.
- Verification plan will use public NewManager behavior with envtest plus a TLS httptest server routed through a temporary http.DefaultTransport override, so concurrent manager sweeps prove same effective host+port sharing and different host/port isolation without adding queues.

- Created plan file .ralph/tasks/15-story-http-concurrency-model/01-task-validate-http-concurrency-model_plans/2026-05-19-http-concurrency-validation-plan.md.
- Updated task file with the plan path.
- Plan ends with NOW EXECUTE, so next agent/turn should read tdd skill again and execute the plan instead of replanning.
- Must quit immediately now per Ralph workflow.

- Read task and execution plan for story 15 HTTP concurrency validation.
- Current task file points to the plan and the plan ends in NOW EXECUTE, so proceeding with TDD execution.
- Existing worktree already has Ralph metadata changes from task selection/planning; must preserve and include them later.

- Added first TDD tracer-bullet startup test in internal/startup/manager_test.go.
- Test uses public startup.NewManager, envtest CRDs, a routed TLS httptest server, and three NSXNetworkCloud objects to check same host+port serialization and different-port isolation.
- Next: run focused test and confirm RED before production wiring.

- Focused startup test first failed to compile because I referenced config.NSXAuthConfig, which does not exist.
- Corrected test setup to use config.BasicAuth in config.NSXConfig.Auth.
- Next: rerun focused startup test for behavioral RED.

- Confirmed behavioral RED with envtest assets: startup concurrency test failed because second same-host request reached server before first response release.
- Wired startup.NewManager to construct one shared rate-limited *http.Client via internal/httpratelimit and pass it into every nsxclient.NewClient call from the manager client factory.
- Added structured startup info log for the shared NSX HTTP client configuration.
- Next: rerun focused startup test for GREEN, then add config propagation test.

- Added startup config propagation test for MaxRequestsInFlightPerHost=2 using a unique nsx-b.example.net bucket.
- Test expects two same-host cloud sweeps to reach the routed TLS server before the first response is released.
- Next: run focused startup config propagation test, then both startup tests together.

- Focused startup tests are GREEN together with envtest assets.
- Evidence: TestNewManagerSharesRateLimitedTransportAcrossCloudSweeps passed, proving same effective nsx-a.example.net:443 serialization and nsx-a.example.net:8443 admission while :443 was blocked.
- Evidence: TestNewManagerUsesConfiguredHTTPRateLimiterLimits passed, proving MaxRequestsInFlightPerHost=2 admits two same-host sweeps before first response release.
- Next: run go test -race ./internal/httpratelimit and add/record mockapi-backed integration evidence if needed by acceptance criteria.

- Added mockapi-backed integration test in internal/nsxclient/contract_test.go.
- Test starts sibling ../nsx-t-mockapi, shares one httpratelimit transport across three real nsxclient.Client instances, blocks first logical nsx-mock-a.example.net:80 request, verifies nsx-mock-a.example.net:8080 proceeds, and verifies the second :80 request waits.
- Next: run focused mockapi integration test and fix any compile/runtime issues.

- Focused mockapi integration test passed: go test ./internal/nsxclient -run TestSharedRateLimitedClientConcurrencyAgainstMockAPI -count=1 -v.
- The -v output logs evidence that same logical host nsx-mock-a.example.net:80 shared one in-flight slot and nsx-mock-a.example.net:8080 reached mockapi while :80 was blocked.
- Updated plan checklist items 1-4 to done.
- Next: run focused startup tests and limiter race again as recorded evidence, then full make check/test/test-coverage.

- Full verification passed: make check, make test, make test-coverage.
- make test-coverage showed startup 82.8%, nsxclient 80.4%, stateoperator 80.2%, httpratelimit 87.8%, all packages at or above 80%.
- Next: complete final improve-code-boundaries review, update task evidence and passes=true, run task_switch, then add all files, commit, and push.

- Final improve-code-boundaries review complete: production limiter code stayed in internal/httpratelimit, startup composes one shared NSX HTTP client, nsxclient/stateoperator do not know limiter internals, and no queues/worker pools were introduced.
- Updated task file with concrete verification evidence and set status completed + passes true.
- Marked final boundary checklist item done in the plan.
- Next: run .ralph/task_switch.sh, then add all files, commit, and push.
